rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「염업조합법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Salt Industry Association Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(업무정지의 세부기준) 「염업조합법」 제51조제2항에 따른 업무정지의 세부기준은 별표와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Detailed Standards for Suspension of Business) The detailed standards for suspension of business pursuant to Article 51, Paragraph 2 of the Salt Industry Association Act are as set forth in the attached table .
ADDENDA <Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 782, Feb. 5, 2026>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
